record.title: Chile-side Santa Rosa–Chacalluta migrant road blockade, November 28, 2025
record.scope: International road on Chilean side of Tacna–Arica frontier near Santa Rosa–Chacalluta

record.exceptions: Some passengers crossed on foot during vehicle obstruction; negotiated and category-specific vehicle passage occurred during pauses.

record.relationship: Promotes R5-AM-L002; separate year from R3-AM-010/R3-AM-011 and R5-AM-003/R5-AM-004.
record.status_observation: Evidence dated in cited sources; no assumption of present status.
record.official_rationale: Participants demanded permission to enter Peru to continue toward their home countries.
record.context: Separate from the Peruvian emergency declaration and ordinary documentation checks, which are not coded as blanket closures.
record.uncertainty: Same-day partial traffic release is supported, but local reporting describes renewed blockage and differing vehicle movement; final normalization and precise uninterrupted intervals remain unknown.
